encounter.title: Prologue Boss — Goblin Shaman (6x6 Candidate A, seed 4710)
encounter.notes: LD-005 Prologue Boss 6x6 Candidate A. Board: square6 (6x6), seed 4710, 9 arrows (N1 E4 S0 W4). Phase 1: East 4 HP (IN 6, dmg 1) consumes all 4 E arrows. Phase 2: North 5 HP (CAST IN 3 -> NORM IN 4, +1 Rotate). Solitary original N arrow #1. Rotate CW(+1) turns 4 West arrows into North, giving exactly enough ammo to interrupt the cast on turn 8 and finish the boss with 0 damage. Rotate CCW(-1) turns depleted East into North, starving player of North ammo and suffering 1 boss damage.
